connections.reason: A secant slope in Physics prepares students to recognize an instantaneous derivative in Calculus.
The velocity–time graph becomes a signed-area model for displacement.
Trigonometric ratios explain how vector components depend on angle.
Net force leads naturally to work and mechanical energy.
The definition of a derivative relies on the idea of a limit.

contentKinds.interactive-lesson: One canonical concept, visual, explanatory tabs, worked example, practice and conceptual check. Only reviewed originals reach content/lessons.json.
contentKinds.student-guided-notes: Blank prompts or diagrams accompanying an existing concept; reusable links registered once in assets.
contentKinds.student-lab: Experiment, actual observations or clearly labeled simulation data, uncertainty and interpretation.
contentKinds.formative-quiz: Short practice questions with full reasoning, concept ownership and verified solutions.
contentKinds.summative-assessment: Secure teacher-reviewed test; do not publish protected questions, answers or keys in GitHub Pages.
contentKinds.teacher-edition: Answer keys, teaching notes, licensing review; keep outside the public static deployment.
